_: Voice-over settings (make voice). The key lives only in OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the environment or local.mk, never here. name — the video file name in out/ (default — the name of the topic folder). On top — the main language (first in LANGS), langs.<lang> — overrides for the others: voice, instructions, tempo (speech speed-up), gap (pause between lines, s), pace (multiplier for scene pauses), language, verify.skip. Gemini TTS voices: male — Charon, Orus, Iapetus, Puck, Fenrir; female — Kore, Aoede, Leda, Zephyr.
